title: The Min Min Light Phenomenon
hook: Why does a ghostly light haunt Australia's outback?
headline: The Outback's Mysterious Floating Light

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: The Min Min Light was first reported near Min Min, Queensland in 1918.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: In 1938 Constable H. B. documented the light hovering over a cattle station.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Witnesses in 1970 described the light moving like a vehicle, changing colors.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent studies suggest a rare atmospheric mirage could explain it, yet no consensus exists.

end.line: What do you think causes the Min Min Light?

description: Explore the century-old mystery of Australia's elusive Min Min Light.
